fullSuite.limitation: Diagnostic run started before the final changes. Its failures are reconciled below. The complete suite was not rerun on the final tree; the final complete affected files, all eight affected game seeds and final new-card question replay provide the post-fix evidence.

reconciledFailures.cause: The expected raw commander count and selectable-deck count still described the preceding batch.
reconciledFailures.fix: Preserve the exact assertions and update them to 81 raw commanders and 80 selectable decks.
reconciledFailures.verification: Both complete cases pass in the final affected run.

reconciledFailures.cause: The active unique and native raw definition expectations were stale.
reconciledFailures.fix: Update to 3,514 active unique cards and 2,427 native raw definitions.
reconciledFailures.verification: The complete file passes in the final affected run.

reconciledFailures.cause: Karazikar called a nonexistent game.goad method when its attack trigger resolved.
reconciledFailures.fix: Use the established timed E.goad effect.
reconciledFailures.verification: Human and actual local-AI trigger cases pass; all eight original deterministic seeds with a new deck at the table are replayed through natural game completion. This includes the preceding Reap the Tides, Phantom Premonition and Elven Empire seats.

reconciledFailures.cause: The new batch was included in the legacy set instead of its own addition group.
reconciledFailures.fix: Add and validate the separate 92-name batch; keep the original 1,626-name count and digest unchanged.
reconciledFailures.verification: The complete preservation and disjointness test passes in the final affected run.

reconciledFailures.cases: local-card-images.test.mjs: canonical art and exact manifest
reconciledFailures.cause: Registered Dragon Spirit Token lacked a canonical-name image alias; the exact expected manifest also omitted the new dungeon and token artwork.
reconciledFailures.fix: Map Dragon Spirit to the existing AFC token file and include all source faces, dungeons and token variants in the exact inventory.
reconciledFailures.verification: The complete image file, file signatures, aliases and manifest assertions pass in the final affected run.

reconciledFailures.cases: planeswalker-combat.test.mjs: inventory; planeswalker-decisions.test.mjs: six Liliana cases
reconciledFailures.cause: The inventory omitted Undead Unleashed/Liliana, and her three loyalty actions lacked the sorcery timing flag.
reconciledFailures.fix: Retain exact 37 deck/walker pairs and 110 loyalty paths; add sorcery timing to all three Liliana actions.
reconciledFailures.verification: Both complete files pass, including human and AI paid entry, main-phase/controller timing, Stack resolution and once-per-turn checks for every active walker.

reconciledFailures.cause: The fixed 111-name list omitted eight newly active X spells.
reconciledFailures.fix: Add Dark Salvation, Diviners Portent, Drown in Dreams, Empty the Laboratory, Extract Brain, Hour of Eternity, Klauths Will and Neverwinter Hydra to the exact 119-name inventory.
reconciledFailures.verification: The complete X-mana file passes in the final affected run.
